title: SharePoint and OneDrive agents: OneDrive files as knowledge sources
summary: The briefing's roadmap facts, licensing qualifications and documented controls are supported. It correctly distinguishes legacy SharePoint agents from Agent Builder and reports Microsoft's conflicting licensing guidance rather than resolving it by assumption. One governance path needs an additional supporting citation.
